findings.message: Training needs about 210.59 GiB per GPU but H100 SXM (80 GB) has 80.00 GiB. Weights 17.21 GiB, gradients 17.21 GiB, optimizer 103.28 GiB, activations 72.88 GiB.
findings.hint: Model state dominates. Raise the ZeRO stage from 0 to 3, or increase tensor parallelism.

findings.message: capping the attention scores needs a kernel that caps inside it: FlashAttention 2.6 or later does, PyTorch's own scaled_dot_product_attention does not. This layer is counted as that fused kernel, and the generated model uses it when flash-attn is installed.
findings.hint: Without it the cap is computed eagerly and the score matrix is held for the backward pass, which is the memory the fused count leaves out.

findings.message: The logits buffer is 9.77 GiB, which is 94% of all activation memory.
findings.hint: Compute the cross-entropy in chunks over the sequence so the full logits tensor is never materialized.

findings.message: 15000B tokens is 90.1x the compute-optimal budget of 166B. Heavily over-trained, in the range of small models trained on very large corpora.
findings.hint: This is fine when inference cost matters more than training cost, which is usually why it is done.
